create_example: create an Example instance with a prompt string and a topic string for in-context data creation
create_placeholder: create a Placeholder instance with [PROMPT] and [TOPIC] string attributes
test_placeholder_list_placeholders: test the Placeholder.list_placeholders method returns a list of placeholder strings
build_fill_format: build a call to fill_format with a prompt format string and a list of Example objects to produce constructed example strings
summarize_concept_examples: summarize the CONCEPT_EXAMPLES list containing topic-prompt pairs for concept-based in-context learning
